title: LOB hierarchy - discover a LOB, then its server groups and user groups
why: The foundation chain. Every other flow needs a real LOBID and a real group id. Hardcoding them makes a test environment-bound; discovering them makes it portable. Hop 3 deliberately re-reads the same data through a second endpoint to prove the two agree.

hops.name: GetLOBList
hops.note: Selected by name so the id is discovered, never hardcoded. Result[0] is LOB 1 (O11), which has no user groups - blind first-row chaining would fail here.

hops.name: GetServerGroupList_crosscheck
hops.note: Same data, different controller, and this one returns a BARE ARRAY with no envelope at all. Proves the chain must not assume a single response shape.

hops.name: GetUserGroupList
hops.note: A real join: this endpoint exposes LOBName, not LobId, so the LOB name carried from hop 1 is the join key.
